label: Whatever is GOD_4 can reveal, and can make a revelation recognizable as his by…, from omnipotence
description: Revealing with signs involves no contradiction, so an omnipotent God can do it; only God can give those signs; and, by the open analysis of the primitive RevealsRecognizably, a being that can reveal with signs only God can give reveals recognizably. So every God reveals recognizably. Four open premises; each is needed (omission models in NAMING-VERACITY-BATCH1-CONTROLS).
